svg.aria-label: Learned aerodynamic surrogate: a car-shaped surface point cloud into a dynamic graph CNN, out to a drag coefficient, with a held-out parity plot and measured accuracy
svg.text: LEARNED SURROGATE · GEOMETRY IN, DRAG OUT
A validation score used for checkpoint selection, on a random split rather than the published one.
Trained at 2,048 points: evaluating at 5,000 drops R² to about 0.59, which is why discretisation invariance matters.
The wall-shear-stress head is far weaker. Both numbers belong in the same sentence.
